_leia: Frases das páginas da cathelier (início, lista de peças, ficha da peça), escritas por src/lib/cathelier.mjs. A origem é pt/; esta é a tradução inglesa.
foto.alt: {nome} — laser cut and engraved to order
inicio.quantidade.texto1: Wedding favours, christening keepsakes, place cards, corporate gifts, a season of trophies — anything here can be made in quantity, with a different name cut into every one.
inicio.quantidade.texto2: Tell us roughly what and roughly how many. There is no form to fight with: a message is enough, and we come back with a price and a date.
inicio.mais.texto.um: Cake toppers, signs, trophies, bookmarks, boxes, keyrings. {n} piece in all, and it takes a name.
inicio.mais.texto.varios: Cake toppers, signs, trophies, bookmarks, boxes, keyrings. {n} pieces in all, and every one of them takes a name.
lista.lede.um: {n} piece, made to order. It carries the names, the dates or the words you choose.
lista.lede.varios: {n} pieces, all made to order. Each one carries the names, the dates or the words you choose.
lista.porMedida: Something that is not here? We cut pieces to measure for weddings, christenings, parties, clubs and companies.
ficha.ajuda: Fill these in and we will send you a drawing to approve. Nothing is cut before you say yes.
ficha.garantia.desenho: A drawing to approve before anything is cut
ficha.garantia.mao: Cut, sanded and finished by hand
ficha.muitas: Ordering a lot of them? Ask for a quote and we will price the whole run.
